prompt: As of November 2026, which EU Member States still have not transposed NIS2, and what enforcement action has the European Commission taken against laggards?
assertions: States 24 of 27 Member States have transposed; the outstanding ones are France and Ireland (draft laws pending) and Spain (bill stalled)
States the Commission referred Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, seeking financial penalties (lump sums and daily payments)
Notes the Netherlands has since transposed: its Cyberbeveiligingswet entered into force August 15, 2026
References the earlier procedural steps: letters of formal notice November 2024 and reasoned opinions May 2025
Advises companies in untransposed states to prepare against the directive text rather than wait
